fields.description:
Outcome and context

Emily asked whether a new SLC (Study Link Click) against an inactive Player pushes that Player back to Active. The built automation ties reactivation to a completed Sign-Up specifically, not to a raw click — this ticket closes that gap between what's built and what Emily is picturing.

Current state

BUILD-253 (WAGR-140) reactivates an Inactive Player only when a Sign-Up's Status changes to Completed — a raw SLC/click alone does not reactivate a Player under the current automation. BUILD-178 (WAGR-72) separately notes this as an open question: "Qualifying activity = Completed Sign-Up only for v1 — communicated in the client Q&A doc without objection; chase explicit OK from Emily/Lina."

Proposed solution

Confirm to Emily that reactivation is tied to a completed Sign-Up, not a raw SLC/click, and get her explicit sign-off — closing the open question carried on BUILD-178. No automation change is expected unless she pushes back and wants clicks alone to reactivate.

Acceptance criteria

  1. Emily has an explicit answer distinguishing "SLC/click" from "completed Sign-Up" as the reactivation trigger.

  2. The open question on BUILD-178 (WAGR-72) is resolved and the ticket updated with the outcome.

Dependencies

Depends on BUILD-253 — Player Status: Activate Player + Sign-Up Stamps on Completed Sign-Up (WAGR-140) and the open question on BUILD-178 — Player: Player Status Automation (WAGR-72).

Source

Wagertech Notes / Questions (Emily Vandenberg), Player record doc, reviewed Sep 2026: "Inactive Status Trigger — If/when a new SLC comes in against an inactive player will the logic push that inactive player back to active." https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mp3b1qpJkzKNDztEQpdnv-BYCgUgDdXe5jLuJi-ix1U/edit?tab=t.0
